input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept any restriction on the products or services we develop, buy or sell, so we have deleted the 24-month, all-territory non-compete in § 12.4; it also contradicts § 12.3, which confirms we have given no non-compete or exclusivity commitment. If Vendor needs protection for a specific offering, we could consider a narrow restriction limited to a named competing product, during the term only and capped at 12 months, with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.
input.summary: Delete the 24-month post-term non-compete binding Customer in § 12.4.
